messages:
aisha: FYI vendor marketplace security scanner finished last night. Quick summary: 12 critical findings, 55 high, but most are infra config issues. Attaching raw CSV to the drive.
ben: Can we get SOC report link and the pen-test timeline? Marketplace listing needs artifacts by EOD Friday.
carmen: Pen test is scheduled with ControlSafe for Apr 28. SOC2 Type II is available in compliance bucket: s3://redwood-compliance/marketplace/soc2-2025.pdf — I can create presigned links for external reviewers.
dave: 12 criticals — any customer-impacting ones?
aisha: No customer data exposed. Main criticals: open debug endpoints, metadata endpoint returning instance info, and a misconfigured IAM role allowing broad S3 list. I annotated the scanner output with line numbers.
secops-bot: Alert: HIGH severity S3 bucket ACL found (bucket: redwood-compliance). Ticket created: CS-4523.
ben: Let's triage — assign owners, ETA, and mark which items must be fixed before marketplace submission. We also need a remediation runbook for the partner review.
carmen: Proposal: infra-team owns IAM/S3, eng-platform owns debug/metadata endpoints, sec owns validation + pen-test coordination. I'll make a checklist doc and the artifact index. Who will drive the remediations?
dave: I'll take the debug endpoints. ETA: EOD Thu for fixes + PR.
aisha: Infra will handle the IAM role, aiming for Mon morning. Sec will re-run the scanner after the changes.
ben: For marketplace submission we need: SOC2 pdf, redacted pen-test report, signed security questionnaire, artifact index (filenames + presigned links), and mitigation statements for critical findings. Carmen — can you own the artifact index and presigned links?
carmen: Yes. I'll generate presigned URLs with 7-day TTL and list owners. Legal: please advise on report redaction.
ben: Quick note: marketplace accepts documented compensating controls for non-customer-impacting items, but insists that criticals be fixed pre-listing. I'll confirm with the marketplace PM and update.
secops-bot: Reminder: when sharing pen-test reports externally, attach ROE and ensure NDA is in place.
dave: PR to fix debug endpoints: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/2384 — tests passing. Can someone do a quick review?
aisha: Reviewing now. Sec will validate post-merge and re-run scanner.
carmen: Artifact index draft uploaded: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Xxx... — will replace drive links with presigned S3 URLs before external handoff.
ben: Also include a short remediation snippet for the IAM fix in the bundle. Example presign command for reviewers:
```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-compliance/marketplace/soc2-2025.pdf --expires-in 604800
```
ben: Action recap: Dave — debug endpoints (EOD Thu), Infra — IAM role (Mon morning), Carmen — artifact index + presigned links, Sec — re-scan & verify. I'll coordinate the final compliance submission and notify marketplace PM. :thumbsup:
